integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically. The included program performs finite consistency checks only and is not used as a substitute for proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to the one-positive sign chamber and to angles below the point where its equality geodesics meet a chamber wall. It does not determine the later chamber-crossing envelope. A poorly indexed simultaneous derivation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp fixed-angle profile near minimal regular-simplex sections
